segments.name: Marketplace
segments.description: Digital marketplace for wholesale used vehicles connecting dealers and commercial sellers with buyers in the United States, Canada and Europe.
segments.evidence: Revenue from the Marketplace segment increased $143.4 million, or 11%, to $1,500.8 million for the year ended December 31, 2025, compared with $1,357.4 million for the year ended December 31, 2024.

segments.name: Finance
segments.description: Provides short-term inventory-secured floorplan financing and affiliated solutions to independent used vehicle dealers across North America.
segments.evidence: This is provided primarily to independent used vehicle dealers ("independent vehicle dealers") through our wholly-owned subsidiary, AFC, which has approximately 90 branch locations (hybrid of physical locations and a digital servicing network) throughout North America.

revenueModel.text: The company charges buy and sell fees to vehicle sellers and buyers, sells value-added ancillary products and services, earns finance revenue from floorplan financing, and records gross selling price on vehicles it purchases and resells.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate revenue through buy and sell fees charged to vehicle sellers and buyers on both sides of the transaction, as well as through the sale of value-added ancillary products and services, including SaaS-based remarketing and other supporting technology services, transportation logistics, reconditioning, vehicle inspection and certification, titling, administrative and collateral recovery services and floorplan financing.

changes.text: In 2023, KAR rebranded to OPENLANE and merged its technology platforms into a single marketplace experience.
In 2022, the company sold ADESA's U.S. physical assets.
changes.evidence: the sale of ADESA's U.S. physical assets in 2022

changes.text: In 2019, the company completed a tax-free spin-off of IAA.
changes.evidence: a successful tax-free spin-off of IAA in 2019
